physics-killer-02.title: Aiki da sauya makamashin inji
physics-killer-02.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-02.material: Daga ƙasan hanya mara gogayya (tsayi $0$) an haɗa da'irar tsaye (loop) mai radius $R=4\,\mathrm{m}$. Ana so a sake wani abu mai nauyin $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ daga tsaye a kan hanya don ya zagaya loop sau ɗaya. Idan $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$, wane zaɓi ne ya haɗa daidai, bi da bi, mafi ƙarancin tsayin farawa $h_{min}$ (daga ƙasa) don ya wuce kololuwar loop ba tare da ya bar hanya ba, da ƙarfin tsaye $N$ da hanya ke yi wa abu a kololuwa idan tsayin farawa $15\,\mathrm{m}$?
physics-killer-02.s.s1.prompt: Daga ƙasan hanya mara gogayya (tsayi $0$) an haɗa da'irar tsaye (loop) mai radius $R=4\,\mathrm{m}$. Ana so a sake wani abu mai nauyin $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ daga tsaye a kan hanya don ya zagaya loop sau ɗaya. Idan $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$, wane zaɓi ne ya haɗa daidai, bi da bi, mafi ƙarancin tsayin farawa $h_{min}$ (daga ƙasa) don ya wuce kololuwar loop ba tare da ya bar hanya ba, da ƙarfin tsaye $N$ da hanya ke yi wa abu a kololuwa idan tsayin farawa $15\,\mathrm{m}$?
physics-killer-02.s.s1.explain: Mafi ƙarancin sharaɗi $N=0$: $mg=mv^2/R\Rightarrow v_{top}^2=gR=40$. Daga kiyayewar kuzari $mgh_{min}=mg(2R)+\frac12mv_{top}^2$, $h_{min}=2R+\dfrac{R}{2}=2.5R=10\,\mathrm{m}$. Idan $h=15\,\mathrm{m}$, $v_{top}^2=2g(h-2R)=2\cdot10\cdot7=140$. Daga $mg+N=mv^2/R$, $N=m\left(\dfrac{v^2}{R}-g\right)=2(35-10)=50\,\mathrm{N}$. Amfani da tsayi $2R=8\,\mathrm{m}$ kaɗai yana nufin an manta da kuzarin motsi (amsa mara kyau ①); $N=mv^2/R=70\,\mathrm{N}$ yana nufin an yi watsi da nauyi (amsa mara kyau ②); $90\,\mathrm{N}$ kuskuren alama ne na ƙara nauyi (amsa mara kyau ③).
physics-killer-02.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
physics-killer-02.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
